name: entity-states-viewer-frame
goal: Capture the open state viewer without including pixels outside its viewport.

evidence: The API viewer-open mobile image at 21274769 is 390 by 852, eight pixels taller than the 390 by 844 viewport; it includes underlying page pixels.
The component catalog asserts the viewer and caption are visible but never compares capture bounds with the viewport. The shared state assertion now checks both dimensions.
